text: Neural cellular automaton with dilated multi-scale taps (1, 2, 4, 8, 16 px, sparser further out)
description: Tiny (about 5–8k params) local update rule, runs as a shader anywhere. Dilated taps let the thick borders exposed after a head turn close in about log2(width) steps. Open question: is it "instant" enough, since it needs several iterations?

status.comment: Realised as triangle taps (3 per level, rotated 60 deg per level) on mip levels with radius 1,2,4,8,16 px + exact self tap: 16 taps, 132 inputs, ~2.3k weights. Runs at 1.6 ms for 2x256^2 on the laptop iGPU. Training in progress.
